messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Probabilistic sampling with randomized local search and empirical minimum-area estimation

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving a minimum triangle area of at least 0.0035 can be found by initializing a large-scale random Latin hypercube sampling of candidate point sets, then applying randomized local perturbation moves (displacing a single point by Gaussian noise of decreasing variance) with acceptance determined by Monte Carlo estimation of the minimum triangle area over the 286 triples, where the best empirically observed configurations cluster near a perturbed hexagonal-triangular lattice with edge-length approximately 0.30 and include one point at the square's center."}
